rootCause: The dynamic remote-partition manager correctly registered a QueueChannel consumer after the first F272 fix, but the Batch integration context did not own a default PollerMetadata, so Spring Integration 7.1 failed the late ConsumerEndpointFactoryBean before it could consume correlated replies.
sourceFix: Provide the Spring Integration canonical default-poller bean only when the application has not provided one.
Bound its interval, per-poll message count and receive timeout from validated CpfBatchExecutionProperties.
Exercise the lifecycle regression with a real QueueChannel polling endpoint instead of a DirectChannel shortcut.
nonBypass: No runtime or verifier timeout increase
No override of an application-owned default poller
verificationNext: Java 25 targeted QueueChannel lifecycle tests, complete Batch Runtime suite, exact bootJars and Fresh R43 physical replay with the fixed 90-second boundary
